SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.REVISION FROM KEPRQDT RQDT INNER JOIN KEPQTDT QTDT ON (1 = 1 AND QTDT.BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QTDT.QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QTDT.REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' ) WHERE RQDT.BUYER IN ('KRSTX-0001','KRSTX-0004') AND RQDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND RQDT.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' AND RQDT.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO NOT LIKE 'RE%' AND 0 = (SELECT count(*) FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND STATUS IN ('C','R') AND RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND ATOB_SEND_FLAG <> 'Y') AND RQDT.RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' ORDER BY RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , TO_NUMBER(RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ) , RQDT.REVISION
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT F_SPLIT(REF_NO,'_',1) AS COMPANY_CODE , F_SPLIT(REF_NO,'_',2) AS IF_HEADER_ID , F_SPLIT(REF_NO,'_',3) AS DIVISION_CODE , F_SPLIT(REF_NO,'_',4) AS IF_DETAIL_ID , RD.QUOTATION_NO AS QTA_NO , RD.ATOB_DATE , RD.ATOB_TIME , '' AS RD_DATE , LR.USER_NAME_LOC AS QTA_ADD_USER_NAME , '' AS QTA_REMARK , RD.ITEM_QTY * RD.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS QTA_AMT , RD.STATUS AS IF_STATUS , RD.BUYER_ITEM_NO , RD.DESCRIPTION , RD.SPECIFICATION , RD.UNIT_MEASURE , RD.ITEM_QTY AS QTA_QTY , RD.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS QTA_PRICE , RD.ATOB_REMARK AS QTA_REMARK_DETAIL FROM KEPRQDT RD INNER JOIN ICOMLUSR LR ON (1 = 1 AND LR.USER_ID = RD.KEP_USER_ID ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND RD.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND RD.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND RD.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND RD.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'Y', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'E', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
